prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1491; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now, if that's okay. Then go ahead.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I had just pulled into a space near the store entrance. I was backing out slowly because the lot was crowded, and I had my signal on.

Q: Where was the other vehicle when you first noticed it?

A: It was coming down the aisle behind me, maybe a few car lengths back. I thought it would stop, but it kept coming and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving?

A: Walking speed, really. Maybe three or four miles an hour. It wasn't a hard hit, but I felt a jolt through my seat.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?

A: Yes, and I talked with the other driver briefly. We exchanged insurance information and a police officer came to file a report.

Q: When did you first notice you were hurt?

A: My neck was stiff the next morning, and by the afternoon my lower back was aching. I have been using a heating pad and taking over-the-counter pain relievers. I saw a doctor, who diagnosed a neck and back strain.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after lifting something heavy, but it resolved on its own.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I want to get my car repaired and get back to normal. Thank you.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
